wildcards-section.name: Wild cards
wildcards-section.description: With each wildcard, you can disable randomization for a specific vehicle type

Extras-section.name: Extras
Extras-section.description: A few extra options to make the experience even more enjoyable :D

easyMode.name: Easy Mode
easyMode.description: This option gives the chance to 50% to stay all portals in the original portal

freeMode.name: Free Fly Mode
freeMode.description: This option gives the option to make the camera free in the game

enable-in-editor.name: Enable random textures in editor
enable-in-editor.description: This option enable the texture randomization in the editor

disableBlending.name: Disable Portal Bleding
disableBlending.description: This removes the blending for the portal particules

clones-section.name: Challenge Features
clones-section.description: These do not modify clones from the clones trigger. But can be useful for challenge mode.

enabled.name: Clones in Every Level
enabled.description: Spawns clones from the start of every level. When this is disabled, you can enable them for specific levels in level options.

spawn-delay.name: Initial Delay
spawn-delay.description: Delay between the player spawning and the clones spawning. <cy>This is recommended to be higher than the main delay.</c>

normal-mode.name: Enable in Normal Mode
normal-mode.description: If clones should spawn in normal mode.

editor.name: Enable in Editor
editor.description: If clones should spawn in the editor.

friendly.name: No Damage
friendly.description:
Prevents clones from damaging you.
Suggested by DragosDobrican.

sfx.name: Sound Effects Enabled
sfx.description:
If clones should play sound effects (if the selected style has any)
Toggle suggested by Crafty-Jumper.

styles.name: Clone Style
styles.description:
How the clones should look.
 **<cy>This only recolors the icon (or applies a shader). This does not change the icon from your current icon.**
Selecting multiple styles suggested by NonCloud9.

dev-logging.name: Dev Logging
dev-logging.description: Adds logging that I felt was a bit unnecessary to flood logs if you don't intentionally turn this on
